_comment: LocalProvider settings (src/refactor_ai/providers/local.py). Copy to configs/model.local.json, which Git ignores. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory. Keys starting with an underscore are comments.
_python: Training-environment interpreter that runs the model worker; on Linux use ../.venv-train/bin/python.
_model_dir: Local snapshot from training/download_model.py at exactly model_revision.
_adapter: Optional LoRA adapter: set adapter_dir and adapter_id together. adapter_sha256 (adapter_model.safetensors) and adapter_config_sha256 (adapter_config.json, which sets the LoRA scaling) are verified when given. A broken or mismatching adapter is a load error, never a fallback to the base model.
_device: cuda or cpu; dtype bfloat16, float16 or float32 (bfloat16 needs an Ampere or newer GPU).
_load_timeout_s: Upper bound for starting the worker and loading the model; per-call generation limits come from GenerationConfig.timeout_s.
